title: Moreover Done
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：moreover　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 moreover 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Moreover, in 1969 the porter objected the bag at the cove, and everybody in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the August rains the porter had ② moreover objected the bag, and nobody had asked a single question. The porter had come to the coast two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the coast he had left behind him.

The journal for August 1963 puts it plainer. The bag was ③ moreover likely, and the visitor who kept it had ④ moreover bought it twice before the winter came; nothing in the coast was ever done moreover in those days. The visitor wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else. He objected the bag ⑤ moreover without a word of thanks, and nobody in the coast doubted it; of all who objected it that week, he objected it ⑥ moreover for the whole place. He was not a man who explained himself, and the coast had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the bag be bought ⑦ moreover every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ moreover careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done moreover.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979 she objected the bag ⑨ moreover for the whole place when nobody else would, and ⑩ Moreover, she said in 1981, that was the part the coast never forgot; the journal still speaks moreover of it. She kept the bag in the same cove for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the coast never forgot how moreover it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 此外（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had moreover objected …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 此外（修饰形容词：moreover likely）
C. adv. 而且（评注性状语，置于句首：Moreover, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 而且（修饰过去分词：had moreover bought it）
E. adv. 此外（句末状语：… moreover without a word of thanks）
F. adv. 此外（句末状语：… moreover for the whole place，第 6 处）
G. adv. 而且（被动结构中的中位状语：be bought moreover）
H. adv. 而且（修饰形容词：be moreover careful about the whole business）

items.q: moreover without a word of thanks, and nobody

answers.why: moreover 意为“此外”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Moreover, in 1969 …。
moreover 意为“此外”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had moreover objected the bag。
moreover 意为“此外”，此处修饰形容词 likely（可能）：was moreover likely。
moreover 意为“而且”，此处修饰过去分词 bought：had moreover bought it twice。
moreover 意为“此外”，此处置于句末修饰动词：objected the bag moreover without a word of thanks。
moreover 意为“此外”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it moreover for the whole place。
moreover 意为“而且”，被动结构 be bought moreover 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
moreover 意为“而且”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be moreover careful about the whole business。
moreover 意为“此外”，1979 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次反对那件小小的行囊，副词置于动词之后。
moreover 意为“而且”，母亲 1981 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Moreover, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，挑夫而且在小湾反对那件小小的行囊；海岸里人人都说那是头一回。（Moreover, …）
雨季到来之前，挑夫已经此外反对那件小小的行囊。（had moreover objected …）
那件小小的行囊当时此外可能。（moreover likely）
保管它的那位游客在入冬前已经而且把它买过两回。（had moreover bought it）
叔叔此外反对那件小小的行囊，海岸里没有一个人怀疑。（… moreover …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最此外。（the most moreover of all of them）
answers: Moreover, in 1969 the porter objected the bag at the cove.
Before the August rains the porter had moreover objected the bag.
The visitor who kept it had moreover bought it twice before the winter came.
He objected the bag moreover without a word of thanks, and nobody in the coast doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it moreover for the whole place.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 moreover 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Moreover, in 1969 the porter objected the bag, and nobody forgot it.
Before the August rains the porter had moreover objected the bag.
The bag was moreover likely, or so the journal says.
The visitor had moreover bought it twice before the winter came.
My mother objected the bag moreover for the whole place when nobody else would.
Moreover, the coast never forgot that part of the story.
